$comment: The compatibility-cleanup gate every tagged release needs, stable, patch or prerelease (docs/releasing.md#pre-tag-compatibility-sign-off). One COMPAT-GATE-<version> issue per release version, opened from the 'Release compatibility gate' issue template, and shared by every milestone and prerelease of that version. A version with no entry cannot be tagged: add it when a delivery milestone is assigned the version. Only exceptionApprover may approve a temporary compatibility exception.
